hello.physical_core: shared APUF, four independent APUFs, four feed-forward APUFs, 24-stage 4x4 PUF, and TP-DOA race core

label: sweep
method: K is read through the frozen research service before, during and after the die is warmed by a nice-19 CPU load on both cores. 'heat': load running, no reads. 'under_load': load running, the reader (nice 0) outruns it. 'cool': load killed, reads continue while the die cools by itself. No external heat source, no power cut; the XADC reading rises by roughly 0.5 C while the load runs, so the 'cool' readings are the settled die temperature.
raw_response_processing: save wire bytes 0..3 in lane order; drop the service's XOR byte
